preconditions.description: The number of data centers n must be between 2 and 100,000.
The number of clients m must be between 1 and 100,000.
The day length h must be between 2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= uj < h for uj in u)
preconditions.description: Each maintenance hour uj for data centers must be within the range of 0 to h-1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ci1 <= n and 1 <= ci2 <= n and ci1 != ci2 for ci1, ci2 in clients)
preconditions.description: Each client's data center indices must be valid and distinct.

postconditions.description: The number of data centers k included in the experiment must be between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: len(set(x)) == k and all(1 <= xi <= n for xi in x)
postconditions.description: The output must contain k distinct data center indices within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: all(u[ci1-1] != u[ci2-1] for ci1, ci2 in clients)
postconditions.description: After shifting, no two data centers storing the same client's data can have the same maintenance hour.
